review:
No silent failures found.

`NotifyTimeout` subclasses `NotifyError`. The only caller, `OrderService.dispatch` in `orders/service.py`, catches `NotifyError`, so timeouts are still caught there. They still go to the outbox for retry, as before.

A timeout can mean the SMS was actually delivered, so the outbox retry could send a courier a duplicate pickup text. That behavior was already there and this PR doesn't change it.
